name: AIOStreams for Apple TV
subtitle: The AIOStreams web app on tvOS, playing through AetherEngine.
description: Unofficial and experimental. The IPA is unsigned: an Apple TV sideloader signs it with your own Apple ID or developer certificate before installing it. AltStore and SideStore read this source, but neither installs to an Apple TV itself; a tvOS sideloader that reads the AltStore source format does.

apps.name: AIOStreams
apps.subtitle: AIOStreams and Jellyfin on Apple TV.
apps.localizedDescription: The AIOStreams web app's standalone build, which signs in to any Jellyfin server, on tvOS. It plays through AetherEngine, so tvOS does what it does for its own apps: Match Content's HDR10, HLG and Dolby Vision modes, and Dolby Atmos. Unofficial and experimental; it uses private tvOS APIs, so it can't go on the App Store.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: AIOStreams connects to media servers on your local network.
